# Knowledge Base: shannon-channel-coding-oq-02-oq-01

**Status: COMPLETED 2026-05-12** (PR #17796 discharged parent axiom). See research/problems/shannon-channel-coding-oq-02-oq-01/knowledge.md for full session history.

## Summary

Bridge slug connecting OQ-03's self-contained Fano inequality to the project-standard `InformationTheory.conditionalEntropy`. The two conditional-entropy definitions are definitionally equal (proved by `rfl`), so OQ-03's `fano_theorem` lifts directly to the standard signature. Combined with the trivial |α|=1 case (`fano_singleton_card_one`), the dispatcher `fano_inequality_proved` discharges the parent's `fano_inequality` axiom exactly. Upstream blocker (ShannonEntropy.lean strong_subadditivity, line 811 linarith failure) was independently fixed in PR #16334. Parent integration shipped in PR #17796.
